faq: Why build an MVP in Flutter?
One codebase reaches both iPhone and Android users, which keeps the first version affordable and simple to change. If your MVP needs heavy device features, we say so before you order.
Can you help decide the feature list?
Yes. We start with a one-page scope, cut it to what your first users need and ask you to approve it. That keeps the build inside the delivery window.
Can the MVP grow into the full product?
Yes. We use a clear structure and standard packages, so a team can keep building on it. Shortcuts, such as simple storage, are written down in the handover notes.
Do I need store accounts to test?
To use TestFlight you need an Apple Developer account, and for Google Play testing a Play Console account. We can also share Android builds directly for quick checks before you set those up.
